semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides cleanroom solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Pophen Environmental Technology (Taizhou) Co., Ltd. specializes in designing and manufacturing cleanroom ceiling and partition wall systems. Their solutions are tailored for microelectronics and semiconductor sectors, focusing on energy-saving and environmentally friendly designs.

regional_presence.China: Pophen operates with a significant construction area exceeding 15 million square meters.
regional_presence.International: The company has a presence in over 15 countries, supported by over 250 international certifications.
